subject: CloudMetrics vendor banking and remittance format (PO mapping)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@cloudmetrics.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor banking and PO remittance format for CloudMetrics

Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for agreeing to onboard CloudMetrics as a Redwood vendor. To finish vendor setup on our side and give Finance what they need for first payments, could you send the following when you have a moment?

- ACH (account and routing) and wire (ABA/SWIFT/beneficiary) details (bank letter or verification PDF is fine)
- Signed W-9 (or W-8 if applicable)
- A sample remittance file that shows how you will encode PO numbers and invoice numbers (CSV or sample XML preferred). Specifically we need to know the exact remittance_reference string we should expect so our AP system can auto-link remits to POs.
- Any vendor enrollment form you require us to sign back (we can return quickly).

Target timeline from Finance: we plan a micro-deposit test before first ACH. If you can confirm availability for a test window early next week that helps.

Appreciate it — copying Marissa and Aditya for internal PO mapping questions.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0113
From: Lydia Park <lydia@cloudmetrics.co>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudMetrics Finance <finance@cloudmetrics.co>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor banking and PO remittance format for CloudMetrics

Jordan —

Thanks — attaching what you asked for. See attached: CloudMetrics_W9.pdf and CloudMetrics_Bank_Verification.pdf, plus a small remit_sample.csv showing the fields we populate. Quick notes from our side:

- ACH: Account ending **4321** / Routing 021000021 (Wells Fargo).
- Wire: Beneficiary: CloudMetrics, Inc.; Account 123456789; ABA 121000248; SWIFT WFBIUS6S.
- Remittance: our remittance file includes columns: PO, INVOICE, AMOUNT, REMIT_REFERENCE. We populate REMIT_REFERENCE as a concatenation: "PO_NUM|INV_NUM" (e.g., PO12345|INV67890). We can also include a separate PO field if you prefer. Sample CSV attached (remit_sample.csv).
- Attached bank verification is a bank letter (dated 2028-05-20).

We can accept a micro-deposit test any time on 2028-05-31 or 2028-06-01. Let me know which you prefer and we will schedule.

I attached a signed vendor enrollment PDF as well — the person who handles onboarding here signed on our side (CloudMetrics_Vendor_Enrollment_signed.pdf).

Best,
Lydia Park
Head of Finance Ops
CloudMetrics, Inc.
lydia@cloudmetrics.co
(617) 555-2204
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@cloudmetrics.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 29 May 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor banking and PO remittance format for CloudMetrics

Lydia —

Received the attachments, thanks — they look good. Two quick clarifications so we can finalize our AP mapping:

1) In your sample you show both a "PO" column and REMIT_REFERENCE that concatenates PO|INV. Our AP engine will prioritize REMIT_REFERENCE for auto-apply. Can you confirm you will always populate REMIT_REFERENCE in that exact format (PO12345|INV67890) for invoice-level remits?

2) For payment runs that contain multiple invoices across multiple POs, will REMIT_REFERENCE repeat for each line or will there be an aggregated remit row? We prefer line-level references (one remit line per invoice) to keep auto-apply reliable.

Also: Finance asks whether you require any special PO label on our end (e.g., prefix or vendor-specific tag). If not, we'll send PO numbers as-is.

We'd like to schedule the micro-deposit for 2028-05-31 morning (PST). Aditya — can you confirm internal capacity to run the test that day? Marissa — once Lydia confirms remittance format we will hand to AP for mapping.

Thanks,
Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lydia Park <lydia@cloudmetrics.co>
Date: Wed, 29 May 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor banking and PO remittance format for CloudMetrics

Jordan / Lydia —

Quick internal note from AP: we can map REMIT_REFERENCE to our invoice header and auto-apply when it matches the pattern PO_NUM|INV_NUM. No special prefix required on PO numbers. For multi-invoice payments we prefer each invoice have its own remit line (one-to-one). If CloudMetrics aggregates, AP will need either a breakdown CSV or a remittance mapping file; otherwise we'll route to manual apply.

Aditya — please confirm we can run the micro-deposit on 5/31 AM and capture the micro-deposit trace for reconciliation. If all good, I'll open the vendor record and add the bank file and W-9 to the vendor profile this afternoon.

Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Lydia Park <lydia@cloudmetrics.co>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudMetrics Finance <finance@cloudmetrics.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor banking and PO remittance format for CloudMetrics

Jordan / Marissa / Aditya —

Thanks for the confirmation. To recap and confirm next steps:

- We will populate REMIT_REFERENCE in the exact format PO_NUM|INV_NUM for every invoice line (no aggregated remit rows). Example: PO12345|INV67890.
- Micro-deposit test is scheduled for 2028-05-31 between 09:00-11:00 PST. We will watch for the two small deposits and confirm when received.
- First production ACH will follow after micro-deposit verification; we expect to receive a memo with the remittance mapping on the payment run and will include the same REMIT_REFERENCE on all remittance rows.

Attached again: CloudMetrics_Vendor_Enrollment_signed.pdf (signed copy). If AP needs a CSV mapping sample for internal use, we can generate a one-off sample of a real payment file — let me know.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lydia
